title: CALM: A Multi-task Benchmark for Comprehensive Assessment of Language Model Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual name substitution using male, female, and gender-neutral names in diverse templates across question-answering, sentiment analysis, and natural language inference tasks, evaluating disparities in model performance (accuracy) compared to a baseline.

Counterfactual name substitution using names associated with Caucasian, African American, Hispanic, and Asian demographics in diverse templates across question-answering, sentiment analysis, and natural language inference tasks, evaluating disparities in model performance (accuracy) compared to a baseline.
